UPPER FACE. [8] [Chim.]
A flushing of cheeks with some general heat, and accelerated pulse.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Chim.]
Toothache, < after eating and from exertion.
Cannot close teeth at night, jaws feel stiff, sleeps with open mouth. θ Toothache.
Toothache, > by cold water.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Chim.]
Agreeable sensation in stomach, soon after, followed sometimes by an extraordinary increase of appetite.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Chim.]
Organic disease of liver with ascites.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Chim.]
Abdominal and renal dropsies, in broken down constitutions and intemperate subjects.
Ascents and swelling of legs.
Ascites in consequence of organic affection of liver.
Scrofulous swelling of abdominal glands ; enlarged mesenteries.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Chim.]
Obstinate constipation. θ Renal disturbances. θ Cystitis.
Constipation and hemorrhoids. θ Dysuria.
Constipation, stool every third day. θ Vesical irritability.
Sensation of swelling in perineum on sitting down, as if a ball was pressing against it. θ Urinary troubles.
Acute prostitis from sitting on a cold, wet stone ; pain and dysuria, which increased to complete retention from swelling of prostate ; pain and soreness in perineum, with sensation as if sitting on a ball.
Ineffectual urging to stool. θ Dysuria.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Chim.]
Constant pain in region of kidneys ; urine scanty, dark colored, fetid, and very thick, depositing a copious sediment ; obstinate constipation.
Frequent desire to urinate, with scanty urine. θ Urinary difficulty.
Vesical tenesmus, from prolapsus or retroversion.
Pressing fulness in region of bladder. θ Nephritis. θ Cystitis.
Strangury.
Constant disposition to urinate ; as often as every hour or two ; passes only a small quantity.
Urging to urinate after voiding urine. θ Nephritis, etc.
Difficult urination, cutting, scalding pain ; sometimes stream is split, at other times small as a thread, or in drops. θ Stricture.
Catarrhal affection of bladder.
Urethritis with purulent or profuse mucous discharge.
Great quantities of thick, ropy, bloody mucus in urine.
Color of urine changed from that of brick-dust to green tea.
Urine scanty, frequently voided with much pressing pain before, scalding and smarting during and after, and vesical tenesmus. θ Dysuria.
Burning, pricking pain during emission of urine. θ Obstinate vesical irritability.
Urine high colored, depositing a copious mucous sediment. θ Dysuria.
Tenderness of anterior portion of vagina (bladder) and urethra. θ Dysuria.
Constant urging to urinate without sufficient discharge ; catheter will not enter ; < when sitting, walks about.
Causes mucous sediment to disappear from urine. θ Cystitis. θ Nephritis. θ Dropsy, etc.
Scanty urine, with muco-purulent sediment.
Albuminuria occurring during Bright's disease.
Hæmaturia from long-lasting gonorrhœa.
Clots of coagulated blood pass with urine.
Dropsy from renal disease.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Chim.]
Smarting pain from neck of bladder whole length of urethra to meatus.
Excessive itching and painful irritation of urethra from end of penis to neck of bladder. θ Urinary difficulty.
Sensation of swelling in perineum, as if in sitting down a ball was pressing against it. θ Urinary difficulty.
Disease of prostate with waste of prostatic fluid.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Chim.]
Prolapsus and slight uterine leucorrhœa. θ Dysuria.
Rapid atrophy of breasts.
Atrophy or tumors of mamma.
Lump in left breast broke, leaving small, irregular ulcer with ragged, everted edges, sloughing and discharging fetid pus. θ Cancer of breast.
Scirrhous tumor of right breast, about an inch in diameter ; hard, but movable ; nipple drawn in ; a good deal of sharp pain in tumor and in axillæ.
Painful tumor of mamma in a young unmarried woman.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Chim.]
A most uncommon sensation in small of back, in region of kidneys ; sometimes on one side of spine, sometimes on other, as if something was fluttering within, without occasioning pain or uneasiness of any sort.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Chim.]
Acute rheumatism of shoulder.
   

NERVES. [36] [Chim.]
Inward trembling without mental disturbance. θ Toothache.
Strength improved. θ Liver complaint.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Chim.]
Would have slept well if he had not been constantly waked by calls to make water. θ Vesical irritability.
Sleeps with open mouth, cannot close the jaws. θ Toothache.
   

FEVER. [40] [Chim.]
Hectic fever and night sweats. θ Cystitis, or renal disease.
Flushing of cheeks, with some general heat and accelerated pulse.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Chim.]
Enlarged lymphatic and mesenteric glands.
   

SKIN. [46] [Chim.]
Jaundice and dropsy.
